items.title: England skittle Pakistan at Headingley on Root's return as Test captain
items.summary: Joe Root's second spell as England Test captain began with his side skittling Pakistan for 171 at Headingley as Ollie Robinson and Josh Tongue each bagged five-wicket hauls around a lengthy rain delay and a brief fightback from the tourists.

items.title: Classy Brighton in amazing gesture to 407 fans who travelled to Arctic Circle for Conference League clash
items.summary: BRIGHTON’S players have paid for the ticket of every Albion fan who has made the trip to their Conference League play-off in the Arctic Circle. The Seagulls squad have also shelled out for a T-shirt and a scarf to each of their 407 supporters attending their clash against Tromso in Northern Norway.
